        """Create a new widget."""

    def setToastActive(self, arg: bool, /) -> None:
        """Set whether the toast stands in for the status bar."""

    def showHint(self, text: str) -> None:
        """Show a short message in the toast's place, for a few seconds. Unlike
        the errors it shows even when the toast is not active: it is what to do
        next, e.g., how to leave presentation mode.
        """

    def setHUDActive(self, arg: bool, /) -> None:
        """Set whether the heads up display is shown at all. Separate from the
        display's own options so that turning it off for presentation does not
        forget what was being shown.
        """
